questions.explain: Since v4 (September 2026) the `mavsdk` package is a native binding through a C wrapper, with no gRPC and no second process; the old gRPC client lives on as `mavsdk-grpc`.
Subscriptions are endless; in 4.x a one-off value comes from `await tel.position()`.

questions.q: PX4 leaves Offboard right after start. The cause:
options: Setpoints before start or below 2 Hz
questions.explain: You need an initial setpoint and a continuous stream.
The project is not being developed.

questions.q: The preferred bridge for PX4 + ROS 2:
questions.explain: MAVROS is for ArduPilot/ROS or special cases.

questions.q: Who must provide safety when the companion script "dies"?
options: The script itself, through try/except blocks
questions.explain: The companion advises, the autopilot decides.

questions.q: Waiting for `health.is_global_position_ok` without a timeout on a vehicle without GPS leads to:

options: One big packet sent through MAVFTP
A MAVSDK protocol of its own
questions.explain: The upper layers implement the same microservices.
